# True Peak

> True Peak is an automated A&R assistant and music label demo submission inbox. It processes audio uploads, performs DSP engineering checks (such as tempo, loudness, clipping, phase, and scale), and organizes tracks inside a visual Kanban workflow.

## Key Features
- **DSP Audio Analysis:** In-browser and backend detection of BPM, integrated LUFS, stereo phase correlation, dynamic range (Crest Factor), digital clipping (True Peak), and musical key (Camelot Wheel).
- **Sonic Signature Rules:** Fully customizable filters allowing labels to define expected BPM, LUFS target, scale, and format rules.
- **Automated Rejection:** Automatically rejects tracks that violate critical technical limits, giving producers immediate feedback.
- **Integrated Kanban Board:** Visually track submissions from Inbox to Shortlist, Approved, and Rejected stages.
- **Automated CRM & Emailing:** Quick contact with producers via pre-built templates containing auto-filled variables.
- **Lossless Audio Streaming:** Online Web Player to audit submitted WAV and FLAC masters in high quality.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Radix UI.
- **Backend:** Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Pytest.
- **DSP Analysis:** Web Audio API (frontend simulation) and specialized python modules (backend).

## Pricing Tiers
- **Free:** $0/mo. Up to 10 submissions/month, basic analysis, personal link, lightweight preview streaming.
- **Indie:** $29/mo. Up to 100 submissions/month, DSP and structural filters, 100 emails/month, 7 days of HQ lossless storage.
- **Pro:** $79/mo. Up to 500 submissions/month, Camelot Wheel harmonic filter, 500 emails/month, 14 days of HQ lossless storage.
